_schema: First-pass Stage-A polygon admin-unit lists. Per locked pre-reg §2 (Entry 002, 2026-05-17), each polygon marks a founding-atrocity geography where chronic IDP burden has lived for decades. Polygons here are built by dissolving GADM admin-2 units that match the historical operational/expulsion extent documented in academic + primary sources. Verification pass against source maps remains a follow-up step before locking the polygon for analysis use.
_methodology_note: Alternative to CV-based polygon tracing from historic maps (which introduces ground-control-point error). Admin-unit-list dissolution is reproducible, auditable, and matches how most historic-violence-zone empirical work codes geography.

colombia_la_violencia_1948_1958.method: department-level dissolution (Phase 1 first-pass; municipio-level subdivision deferred to verification)
sources: Roldán M., Blood and Fire: La Violencia in Antioquia, Colombia 1946-1953 (Duke UP, 2002)
Sánchez G. & Meertens D., Bandoleros, gamonales y campesinos: el caso de la Violencia en Colombia (1983)
Oquist P., Violence, Conflict, and Politics in Colombia (Academic Press, 1980)
CNMH ¡Basta Ya! Colombia: Memorias de guerra y dignidad (2013) Map 2
colombia_la_violencia_1948_1958.verification_status: FIRST_PASS — locked dept list; municipio subdivision pending review against CNMH Map 2 + Roldán regional appendix

sudan_fur_dar_pre1994.method: state-level dissolution corresponding to pre-1994 Darfur Province (modern Darfur is 5 states post-2012 split)
sources: Daly M.W., Darfur's Sorrow: A History of Destruction and Genocide (Cambridge UP, 2007)
De Waal A., Famine that Kills: Darfur, Sudan (Oxford UP, 2005, rev. ed.)
Anglo-Egyptian Survey of Sudan (pre-1994 Darfur Province boundary)
sudan_fur_dar_pre1994.verification_status: FIRST_PASS — modern 5-state Darfur aligns with pre-1994 Darfur Province extent within ~50km on eastern boundary

drc_kasai_1959_1965.method: province-level dissolution covering modern Kasai + Kasai-Central + Kasai-Oriental + Lomami + Sankuru (pre-2015 = Kasai-Occidental + Kasai-Oriental)
sources: Young C. & Turner T., The Rise and Decline of the Zairian State (U Wisconsin Press, 1985) — Kasai chapter
Lemarchand R., Political Awakening in the Belgian Congo (U California Press, 1964)
Stearns J.K., Dancing in the Glory of Monsters (PublicAffairs, 2011) — Kasai context ch. 1
CRDA UCL Louvain — Centre de Recherche et de Documentation sur les Afriques
drc_kasai_1959_1965.verification_status: FIRST_PASS — province-level lock; territoire subdivision deferred pending verification against Young & Turner + Stearns admin maps

yemen_six_wars_2004_2010.method: admin-2 district-level dissolution from ICG MER N°86 explicit district citations + governorate-level expansion zones
sources: ICG Middle East Report N°86, Yemen: Defusing the Saada Time Bomb (27 May 2009)
ICG Middle East Report N°114 (Yemen follow-up)
Salisbury P., Yemen's Houthi Conflict (Chatham House, 2015)
yemen_six_wars_2004_2010.verification_status: FIRST_PASS — district-level extracted from ICG MER N°86 text; governorate-level expansion zones aligned with literature consensus
